purpose: Canonical research layer for exhaustive Super Soul enumeration, acquisition, effects, Limit Burst behavior, provenance, and verification.
source_policy: Preserve source/version conflicts; never infer undocumented trigger timing, magnitude, drop rates, or stacking behavior.
research_notes: Super Souls are a separate equipment domain from skills and QQ Bangs.
The repository must distinguish cataloguing a soul from verifying every trigger, magnitude, duration, and Limit Burst interaction.

Current research indicates Super Souls can originate from Parallel Quests, Expert Missions, raids, TP Medal Shop rotations, story content, and other acquisition systems; each source must be resolved per record.
QQ Bang statistics and Super Soul effects must not be conflated.
Community descriptions are evidence, not automatic canonical values.

sources.name: Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 Wiki Super Souls guide
